entries.title: Isaiah 23:1
segments: ¶The burden against Tyre. Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, So that there is no house, no harbor; From the land of Cyprus it is revealed to them.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:2
segments: Be still, you inhabitants of the coastland, You merchants of Sidon, Whom those who cross the sea have filled.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:3
segments: And on great waters the grain of Shihor, The harvest of the River, [is] her revenue; And she is a marketplace for the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:4
segments: Be ashamed, O Sidon; For the sea has spoken, The strength of the sea, saying, "I do not labor, nor bring forth children; Neither do I rear young men, [Nor] bring up virgins."

entries.title: Isaiah 23:5
segments: When the report [reaches] Egypt, They also will be in agony at the report of Tyre.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:6
segments: Cross over to Tarshish; Wail, you inhabitants of the coastland!

entries.title: Isaiah 23:7
segments: [Is] this your joyous [city], Whose antiquity [is] from ancient days, Whose feet carried her far off to dwell?

entries.title: Isaiah 23:8
segments: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning [city], Whose merchants [are] princes, Whose traders [are] the honorable of the earth?

entries.title: Isaiah 23:9
segments: The LORD of hosts has purposed it, To bring to dishonor the pride of all glory, To bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:10
segments: Overflow through your land like the River, O daughter of Tarshish; [There is] no more strength.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:11
segments: He stretched out His hand over the sea, He shook the kingdoms; The LORD has given a commandment against Canaan To destroy its strongholds.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:12
segments: And He said, "You will rejoice no more, O you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, cross over to Cyprus; There also you will have no rest."

entries.title: Isaiah 23:13
segments: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans, This people [which] was not; Assyria founded it for wild beasts of the desert. They set up its towers, They raised up its palaces, [And] brought it to ruin.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:14
segments: Wail, you ships of Tarshish! For your strength is laid waste.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:15
segments: ¶Now it shall come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as [in] the song of the harlot:

entries.title: Isaiah 23:16
segments: "Take a harp, go about the city, You forgotten harlot; Make sweet melody, sing many songs, That you may be remembered."

entries.title: Isaiah 23:17
segments: And it shall be, at the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her hire, and commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:18
segments: Her gain and her pay will be set apart for the LORD; it will not be treasured nor laid up, for her gain will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for fine clothing.
